name: Mirror Universe
role: Headline finisher: get low (Death's Shadow shell), swap totals away. One-shot, sacrifices itself.
note: Named anchor. Non-creature artifact, era ok. Honest one-shot life swap.
text: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Exchange life totals with target opponent. Activate only during your upkeep.

name: Death's Shadow
role: Low-life payoff the user wants viable: huge when life near 0. The reason the shell exists.
printings: 2XM, HA4, MB2, MM3, SCH, SLD, SLP, WWK
note: Out-of-block creature, explicitly requested; structural anchor of life-as-resource.
text: This creature gets -X/-X, where X is your life total.

name: Shadow of Mortality
role: Nearest equivalent to nonexistent 'Shadow of the Industry': cheaper the lower your life.
note: 'Shadow of the Industry' NOT in DB; this is the closest low-life payoff. Out-of-block.
text: If your life total is less than your starting life total, this spell costs {X} less to cast, where X is the difference.

name: Transcendence
role: Weird life-as-resource engine: survive at 0, lose at 20, lifeloss becomes huge lifegain. Decision-dense.
note: In-block (TOR). Perfect on-philosophy build-around; very low power.
text:
You don't lose the game for having 0 or less life.
When you have 20 or more life, you lose the game.
Whenever you lose life, you gain 2 life for each 1 life you lost. (Damage dealt to you causes you to lose life.)

name: Phyrexian Unlife
role: Survive below 0 (poison instead). Core shell that makes Death's Shadow / Ad Nauseam honest.
note: Non-creature, era ok. The classic life-as-resource survival enabler.
text:
You don't lose the game for having 0 or less life.
As long as you have 0 or less life, all damage is dealt to you as though its source had infect. (Damage is dealt to you in the form of poison counters.)

name: Soul Echo
role: Survive at 0 while echo counters last; counters-matter + life buffer. Fragile, interactive.
note: Non-creature. Counter-themed life shield; ties to cube's counters theme.
text:
This enchantment enters with X echo counters on it.
You don't lose the game for having 0 or less life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this enchantment if there are no echo counters on it. Otherwise, target opponent may choose that for each 1 damage that would be dealt to you until your next upkeep, you remove an echo counter from this enchantment instead.

name: Lich
role: Iconic fragile life-as-resource: drop to 0, survive, gain=draw. Dies = you lose. Build-around.
note: Non-creature. Extremely fragile (any damage/removal can kill you). On-philosophy.
text:
As this enchantment enters, you lose life equal to your life total.
You don't lose the game for having 0 or less life.
If you would gain life, draw that many cards instead.
Whenever you're dealt damage, sacrifice that many nontoken permanents. If you can't, you lose the game.
When this enchantment is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you lose the game.

name: Children of Korlis
role: Recover all life lost this turn: the Ad Nauseam / Mirror Universe payoff (spend life, get it back).
note: Out-of-block (TSP) but structural: life-loss recovery for the resource shell; user wants Ad Nauseam line.
text: Sacrifice this creature: You gain life equal to the life you've lost this turn. (Damage causes loss of life.)

name: Angel's Grace
role: One-shot 'can't lose this turn' + damage can't drop below 1: protects the Ad Nauseam / big-lifeloss turn.
printings: MMA, PLST, PTSR, SOA, TSP, TSR
note: Non-creature, honest one-shot. User references it (#13) as combo protection.
text:
Split second (As long as this spell is on the stack, players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.)
You can't lose the game this turn and your opponents can't win the game this turn. Until end of turn, damage that would reduce your life total to less than 1 reduces it to 1 instead.

name: Bond of Agony
role: Pure life-as-resource burn: pay X life, each opponent loses X. Honest one-shot.
note: Named. Spell, life stapled to it. Great with Transcendence / survive-at-0.
text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay X life.
Each other player loses X life.

name: Unspeakable Symbol
role: In-block pay-life mana sink: pay 3 life for a +1/+1 counter, repeatable. Lowers own life for Death's Shadow.
note: In-block (SCG). Counters + life-as-resource; self-lowers life synergy.
text: Pay 3 life: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.

name: Font of Agonies
role: Blood-counter payoff for paying life: every life payment fuels repeatable creature removal.
note: Named (Phyrexian-mana / pay-life payoff). Counters-matter. Needs pay-life enablers to fire.
text:
Whenever you pay life, put that many blood counters on this enchantment.
{1}{B}, Remove four blood counters from this enchantment: Destroy target creature.

name: Greed
role: Low-power pay-life draw engine: the honest mana/life sink for the life-resource deck.
printings: 4BB, 4ED, 6ED, 7ED, C13, C21, LEG, MH2, REN, SLD
note: Non-creature. Slow {B}+2 life per card; era-appropriate Necropotence-lite.
text: {B}, Pay 2 life: Draw a card.

name: Dark Tutelage
role: Passive life-as-resource card advantage: reveal top, draw, lose life = its MV. Self-lowering.
note: Non-creature. Variable lifeloss feeds Death's Shadow / Font of Agonies.
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, reveal the top card of your library and put that card into your hand. You lose life equal to its mana value.

name: Dark Prophecy
role: Aristocrats pay-life draw: creatures dying draw cards and bleed your life as a resource.
note: Non-creature. Triple-black greed; pairs with weak sac fodder.
text: Whenever a creature you control dies, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.

name: Underworld Connections
role: Land becomes a pay-1-life draw engine. Slow, grindy life-as-resource advantage.
printings: C15, C17, DDM, PW24, RTR, VOC
note: Aura on a land; inert without a land but trivially enabled. Low power.
text:
Enchant land
Enchanted land has "{T}, Pay 1 life: Draw a card."

name: Nihilistic Glee
role: Hellbent pay-life draw + small drain: empties hand then converts life to cards. Graveyard/discard synergy.
note: Non-creature. Very low power; ties to discard/hellbent theme.
text:
{2}{B}, Discard a card: Target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Hellbent — {1}, Pay 2 life: Draw a card. Activate only if you have no cards in hand.

name: Promise of Power
role: One-shot life-as-resource: draw 5 lose 5, or a demon. Honest, spell-stapled.
note: Modal spell; the draw-5-lose-5 mode is the life-resource line.
text:
Choose one —
• You draw five cards and you lose 5 life.
• Create an X/X black Demon creature token with flying, where X is the number of cards in your hand.
Entwine {4} (Choose both if you pay the entwine cost.)

name: Blood Celebrant
role: Pay-1-life ramp/fixing: turns life into any-color mana. In-block engine for life-resource decks.
note: In-block creature (LGN). Channel-lite but rate-limited; self-lowers life.
text: {B}, Pay 1 life: Add one mana of any color.

name: Cabal Archon
role: In-block drain: sac a Cleric to drain 2 / gain 2. The black gain-engine for Sanguine Bond / Wound Reflection.
note: In-block (ONS). Repeatable lifegain trigger for the drain payoffs; Cleric shell.
text: {B}, Sacrifice a Cleric: Target player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.

name: Ebonblade Reaper
role: Halve your own life on attack (fuels Death's Shadow), halve theirs on hit. In-block life-as-resource aggro.
note: In-block (ONS). Self-lowering life + a finisher clock; morph.

name: Tavern Swindler
role: Coin-flip life sink: pay 3 life, flip to gain 6. Life-as-resource + the cube's coin-flip theme.
printings: BBD, DDM, IMA, M21, PLST, RTR, SNC
note: Out-of-block creature; rare double-theme fit (life + coin-flip). Very low power.
text: {T}, Pay 3 life: Flip a coin. If you win the flip, you gain 6 life.

name: Sanguine Bond
role: Lifegain-to-drain payoff: gain life, opponent loses that much. Pairs with Cleric lifegain shell.
printings: C13, C17, C21, IMA, LTC, M10, M14, SLD, TSR, WOT
note: Named. Kept SINGLE copy of this effect (excluded Vito/Defiant Bloodlord). NO Exquisite Blood (infinite).
text: Whenever you gain life, target opponent loses that much life.

name: Wound Reflection
role: Life-loss doubler: opponents lose again at end step what they lost this turn. Drain amplifier.
note: Named. Slow 6-drop payoff; pairs with any drain/burn.
text: At the beginning of each end step, each opponent loses life equal to the life they lost this turn. (Damage causes loss of life.)

name: Tainted Remedy
role: Anti-lifegain: opponents' lifegain becomes lifeloss. Life-matters hatebear + Mirror Universe synergy.
note: Non-creature. Punishes opponent lifegain; combos with giving them your low total.
text: If an opponent would gain life, that player loses that much life instead.

name: False Cure
role: In-block one-shot anti-lifegain punisher: their lifegain costs them 2 life each. Surprise blowout.
note: In-block (ONS) instant. Niche but on-theme; rewards reading opponent lifegain.
text: Until end of turn, whenever a player gains life, that player loses 2 life for each 1 life they gained.

name: Profane Transfusion
role: Mono-black Mirror Universe on a spell: swap totals + make a token of the gap. Honest one-shot finisher.
note: Spell-stapled life swap; expensive, fair. Black version of the Mirror finisher.
text: Two target players exchange life totals. You create an X/X colorless Horror artifact creature token, where X is the difference between those players' life totals.

name: Repay in Kind
role: Set everyone to the lowest life total: one-shot symmetrical reset, you set up to win. Honest spell.
note: One-shot. Pairs with your own low life as the floor; then drain them out.
text: Each player's life total becomes the lowest life total among all players.

name: Stunning Reversal
role: Anti-loss + set self to 1: dodge lethal, draw 7, then swap 1-life away with Mirror Universe.
note: One-shot instant; sets you to 1 = explicit Mirror Universe / Death's Shadow enabler.
text:
The next time you would lose the game this turn, instead draw seven cards and your life total becomes 1.
Exile Stunning Reversal.

name: Near-Death Experience
role: Alternate win: be at exactly 1 life on upkeep. The white life-as-resource win-con build-around.
note: Non-creature alt-win (cube spine). Needs precise life control = decision-intensive.
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have exactly 1 life, you win the game.

name: Test of Endurance
role: In-block alternate win: 50+ life on upkeep wins. Payoff for the Cleric lifegain shell.
note: In-block (JUD) alt-win. The 'gain life to win' end of the axis; slow.
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have 50 or more life, you win the game.

name: Beacon of Immortality
role: Double your life (shuffles back): huge lifegain spike. With Sanguine Bond it's a one-shot drain.
note: One-shot. Pushes toward Test of Endurance; Sanguine Bond turns it lethal.
text: Double target player's life total. Shuffle Beacon of Immortality into its owner's library.

name: Boon Reflection
role: Lifegain doubler: amplifies the Cleric shell and Sanguine Bond drain. Weak alone.
note: Non-creature multiplier; pairs with Test of Endurance / Sanguine Bond.
text: If you would gain life, you gain twice that much life instead.

name: Azor's Elocutors
role: Filibuster alt-win where being damaged removes counters: life-matters race. Named build-around.
note: Out-of-block creature; hybrid W/U (Azorius). Damage-removes-counter = stay-alive win.
text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a filibuster counter on this creature. Then if this creature has five or more filibuster counters on it, you win the game.
Whenever a source deals damage to you, remove a filibuster counter from this creature.

name: Delaying Shield
role: Damage -> delay counters; pay or lose life later. In-block damage-to-counter life buffer (named).
note: In-block (ODY). Damage->counters; counters-matter + life management.
text:
If damage would be dealt to you, put that many delay counters on this enchantment instead.
At the beginning of your upkeep, remove all delay counters from this enchantment. For each delay counter removed this way, you lose 1 life unless you pay {1}{W}.

name: Force Bubble
role: Damage -> depletion counters (prevented until 4). In-block damage-to-counter life shield (named).
note: In-block (SCG). Depletion-counter fog wall; counters theme + survive.
text:
If damage would be dealt to you, put that many depletion counters on this enchantment instead.
When there are four or more depletion counters on this enchantment, sacrifice it.
At the beginning of each end step, remove all depletion counters from this enchantment.

name: Beacon of Destiny
role: Redirect a damage source onto itself: protect your (low) life total. In-block Cleric life shield.
note: In-block (ONS) Cleric. Life-matters defense; protects Death's Shadow / 1-life lines.
text: {T}: The next time a source of your choice would deal damage to you this turn, that damage is dealt to this creature instead.

name: Teroh's Faithful
role: ETB gain 4: the stay-alive Cleric body; trigger for Sanguine Bond and Test of Endurance.
note: In-block (TOR) Cleric lifegain shell; cheap, on-theme.
text: When this creature enters, you gain 4 life.

name: Doubtless One
role: Cleric-count beater that gains life on damage: the lifegain payoff body in the Cleric shell.
note: In-block (ONS) Cleric. Lifegain -> Sanguine Bond drain; scales with the tribe.
text:
Doubtless One's power and toughness are each equal to the number of Clerics on the battlefield.
Whenever this creature deals damage, you gain that much life.

name: Stern Judge
role: Symmetric Swamp-drain each tap: a slow life-attrition engine in the Cleric shell.
note: In-block (TOR) Cleric. Punishes Swamps; life-as-attrition in WB.
text: {T}: Each player loses 1 life for each Swamp they control.

name: Vault Skirge
role: Phyrexian-mana lifelink flyer: cast for 2 life, then trickle life back. Life-as-resource curve filler.
note: Out-of-block creature; Phyrexian-mana pay-life + lifelink. Elo higher; trim if needed.
text:
({B/P} can be paid with either {B} or 2 life.)
Flying
Lifelink (Damage dealt by this creature also causes you to gain that much life.)

name: Postmortem Lunge
role: Phyrexian-mana reanimation: pay 2 life to flash back a creature for a turn. Life-as-resource tempo.
note: Non-creature; Phyrexian-mana pay-life. Named-category (Phyrexian-mana) enabler.
text:
({B/P} can be paid with either {B} or 2 life.)
Return target creature card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.

name: Vizkopa Guildmage
role: Activated Sanguine Bond: this turn, lifegain doubles as drain; also grants lifelink. WB drain engine.
note: Out-of-block creature; the marquee WB life-matters payoff, very low power.
text:
{1}{W}{B}: Target creature gains lifelink until end of turn.
{1}{W}{B}: Whenever you gain life this turn, each opponent loses that much life.

name: Karlov of the Ghost Council
role: Grows on lifegain, eats creatures: turns the Cleric lifegain shell into removal. WB life-matters.
note: Out-of-block creature; counters + lifegain payoff. Trim vs Vizkopa if WB slots tight.
text:
Whenever you gain life, put two +1/+1 counters on Karlov.
{W}{B}, Remove six +1/+1 counters from Karlov: Exile target creature.

name: Cliffhaven Vampire
role: Each lifegain pings opponents for 1: a flying WB drain payoff for the lifegain shell.
note: Out-of-block creature; chosen as the single 'gain->ping 1' copy (excluded Epicure/Blight-Priest).
text:
Flying
Whenever you gain life, each opponent loses 1 life.

name: Final Payment
role: Pay 5 life (or sac) to destroy a creature: honest life-as-resource removal. Cheap WB interaction.
note: Non-creature; the life-paying option is the resource line (also lowers own life).
text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay 5 life or sacrifice a creature or enchantment.
Destroy target creature.

name: Vizkopa Confessor
role: Extort (drain per spell) + pay-life hand disruption ETB: WB life-matters grind. Cleric shell.
note: Out-of-block creature; extort = WB drain mechanic. Marginal pick, trim first if sparing.
text:
Extort (Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay {W/B}. If you do, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain that much life.)
When this creature enters, pay any amount of life. Target opponent reveals that many cards from their hand. You choose one of them and exile it.

name: Rain of Gore
role: Symmetric anti-lifegain: any controller's lifegain becomes lifeloss. BR life-resource hate.
note: Non-creature; BR slot for the anti-lifegain axis. Watch symmetry with own gain.
text: If a spell or ability would cause its controller to gain life, that player loses that much life instead.

name: Phyrexian Arena
role: Iconic pay-life-each-turn draw engine: bleed 1 life per extra card. The clean life-as-resource staple.
printings: 8ED, 9ED, APC, C15, CC2, CN2, DDE, FDN, HA1, HOP, MKC, ONE, PFDN, PLST, PONE, SLD, TD0, WC01
note: Power UPPER BOUND (elo 1353); cleanest pay-life engine. Borderline-strong; cut first if too efficient.
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.

name: Soul Conduit
role: Repeatable Mirror Universe: {6} to swap two players' totals. Slow colorless life-swap finisher.
note: Repeatable but {6}/use = honest, slow. Colorless backup to Mirror Universe; not a free engine.
text: {6}, {T}: Two target players exchange life totals.

name: Axis of Mortality
role: Upkeep swap any two players' totals: white Mirror Universe build-around; political, low power.
note: Repeated swap = borderline vs honest-combo rule, but very weak/symmetrical; include w/ scrutiny.
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may have two target players exchange life totals.
